claims: England and Uruguay drew 1-1 in a friendly at Wembley on March 27, 2026.
The friendly was part of their preparations for the 2026 World Cup.
Ben White marked his England return with an 81st-minute goal.
Fede Valverde equalized via a stoppage-time penalty.
The match took place at Wembley Stadium, London.
Ben White was a goalscorer in the 81st minute.
Fede Valverde was a goalscorer from a 90'+ penalty.
The match was a pre-World Cup friendly.
Marca stated that the match marked a competitive test for both teams.
Reports from an ESPN article and the London Evening Standard stated that England largely controlled the game before a late penalty allowed Uruguay to secure a draw.
A BBC article reported that Ben White made a return to the England squad, scored, and conceded the late penalty
